annotations.title: Compare the texts of a verse

description: Returns one verse across the texts side by side: Hebrew, the Septuagint (matched by the app's verse tables, even where numbered differently), the Targumim, and the Greek and Hebrew New Covenant (New Testament), with the quotations that join them and the Greek words a New Covenant quotation and the Septuagint do and do not share. Use when the user asks how one verse reads in the Hebrew, Septuagint, Targum and New Covenant (New Testament).

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)
